title: Artists open the first Impressionist exhibition
summary: An independent artists’ society opened an exhibition at Nadar’s Paris studio, bringing together painters later associated with Impressionism outside the official Salon.

claims.text: An independent artists’ society opened an exhibition at Nadar’s Paris studio, bringing together painters later associated with Impressionism outside the official Salon.
The National Gallery gives 15 April 1874 as the opening date; the Met independently identifies the exhibition and year.
Monet, Degas, Morisot and Pissarro were among its participants. Their approaches differed; participation did not imply one uniform style.

review.corroboration: The Met historical essay and National Gallery exhibition research agree on the event and year; the latter supplies the opening day.
